defect.title: Coupon SAVE20 can be stacked without limit
defect.description: The checkout accepts SAVE20 repeatedly. Each application subtracts 20% of the original subtotal, producing a negative payable total on the sixth application.
steps_to_reproduce: Enter SAVE20 and submit the coupon form
Repeat the same application six times
Observe total -25.99 and six recorded applications
defect.expected_behavior: A one-use coupon is rejected after its first successful application; the total never becomes negative.
defect.actual_behavior: All six applications succeed. Applied SAVE20 x6 and total -25.99 are visible in the checkout state.
